summary: This clinical trial is testing a medicine called NNC0487-0111 to see how it affects people with excess body weight and knee osteoarthritis, which is a joint disease causing pain and stiffness. The study plans to enroll 400 participants who will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks the same. The trial is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and is currently Recruiting in Phase 3.
